objects.name: ConnectSecure brings adaptive AI testing to vulnerability management
objects.description: ConnectSecure has announced Agentic AI Penetration Testing, a new capability designed to help managed service providers (MSPs) and enterprise security teams better understand which vulnerabilities may be exploitable and require the most immediate attention. Security teams have greater visibility into vulnerabilities than ever before, but determining whether a weakness can actually be exploited, how it could fit into a broader attack path, and what should be remediated first can require significant time and specialized expertise.
